races.title: State Senate, District 14
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Dan Blue
cands.bio: Daniel T. Blue Jr. is a Raleigh attorney and Democrat. He was NC House Speaker (1991–1994), served in the House 1981–2002 and 2006–2009, and has been a state senator for District 14 since 2009. He has been Senate minority leader and was president of the National Conference of State Legislatures.
cands.gaps: We found no documented position from Blue on data centers, homestead property tax relief, limits on investor or foreign land buyers, growth and land conservation, H-1B visas or immigration enforcement, police pay and pensions, or school vouchers beyond his website's general language. His News & Observer candidate questionnaire was only mentioned on his campaign site, and we could not read it. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2020, 2022, 2024 or 2026. No specific bills he sponsored were available to us. We found no controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements in the pages we reviewed. His exact birth city comes only from his campaign biography.

local.label: Roots 100: His campaign biography says he was born in Lumberton and raised in a Robeson County farmhouse, attended North Carolina public schools and NC Central University, and has practiced law in Wake County since 1973.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: He served as NC House Speaker, spent over 20 years in the House and has been a state senator since 2009, including as Senate minority leader. He has been a practicing attorney since 1973, a partner at Thigpen, Blue, Stephens and Fellers from 1976, and later a founding partner of Blue LLP.
qual.why: He has decades of legislative service and chamber leadership as Speaker and minority leader, plus a long law career, which is the top of the rubric for writing law and the budget.
qual.label: He has decades of legislative service and chamber leadership as Speaker and minority leader, plus a long law career, which is the top of the rubric for writing law and the budget.

second-amendment.evidence: His campaign website says he supports implementing "red flag" laws and universal background checks on gun purchases.

pro-life.evidence: His campaign website says he wants to protect women's reproductive freedoms by codifying Roe v. Wade.

prio.label: Matches 0 of 2 priorities; 0 backed by their record, 0 only promised

cands.name: Angela B. McCarty
cands.bio: Republican candidate for NC Senate District 14 in 2024 and 2026. Born in Danville, Virginia; Averett University graduate (1987). Her listed profession is educator. In her own account she has worked as a commercial pilot and flight instructor, an undercover narcotics officer, and a minister. She has held no elected office.
cands.gaps: We found no record of Angela McCarty holding office, so there are no actions in office to report. She did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 candidate survey, so the positions we have come from her 2024 survey. We found no stated position from her on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buying, immigration or H-1B, abortion, or gun laws such as red-flag laws or suppressors. Her survey mentions school safety and being a former police officer, but gives no specific policy on police pay or penalties. Ballotpedia lists no endorsements for her in either race. Her work history comes from her own survey answers and was not confirmed by outside sources. We found no reporting on controversies and no documented foreign ties.

local.label: Roots 55: She was born in Danville, VA and raised in rural Virginia, and said in 2024 that she had lived in North Carolina for over 32 years, which means she moved here as an adult more than 25 years ago.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Her self-described work history includes mill work, flight instruction, commercial piloting, undercover narcotics police work, service as a pilot in the Virginia Defense Force, teaching art and aviation classes, and ministry. Ballotpedia lists her profession as educator. She has held no elected office.
qual.why: She has no legislative or local elected experience and no policy, law or budget career in the record. Her work history is in unrelated occupations, so she falls in the low band.
qual.label: She has no legislative or local elected experience and no policy, law or budget career in the record. Her work history is in unrelated occupations, so she falls in the low band.

school-choice-teachers.evidence: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey she said every parent should be able to choose their child's school and that she supports school vouchers in public and charter schools. She also said North Carolina lags in teacher pay and that this needs to change.

slow-growth-protect-land.evidence: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey she listed protecting forests and wetlands among her policy passions. She named growth and maintaining adequate greenways and forestry as a challenge for the next decade. She did not describe specific policies.

prio.label: Matches 2 of 2 priorities; 0 backed by their record, 2 only promised
